# 03_YouTube-and-Social (wildcard style)

Everything for the channel and for Instagram: banner, profile picture, thumbnail templates, highlight covers, post and story templates.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`banner/`](banner/) | The YouTube banner. |
| [`instagram-highlight-covers/`](instagram-highlight-covers/) | Twelve Instagram highlight covers, 1080 x 1920. |
| [`instagram-posts/`](instagram-posts/) | Six Instagram post templates, 1080 x 1350 (the 4:5 portrait size). |
| [`instagram-stories/`](instagram-stories/) | Four Instagram story templates, 1080 x 1920. |
| [`profile/`](profile/) | Profile pictures. |
| [`thumbnails/`](thumbnails/) | Thumbnail templates, 1280 x 720, in three layouts. |
